import sqlite3, pandas as pd
from datetime import date

con = sqlite3.connect("pos.sqlite")

# parse NgayLap into dates
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT MaHoaDon, MaKhachHang, TinhTrang, NgayLap, TongTienHang FROM don_hang", con)
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['NgayLap'], errors='coerce', format='mixed')

# filter last week: Mon 2026-05-25 .. Sun 2026-05-31, status completed, has customer code
lo, hi = date(2026,5,25), date(2026,5,31)
mask = df['d'].between(lo, hi) & (df['TinhTrang']=='completed') & (df['MaKhachHang'].notna())
rows = df[mask].copy()
print("Orders in window (completed, has customer):", len(rows))
print(rows.head())

# sum line item TriGia per order, then per customer
det = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT MaHoaDon, TriGia FROM chi_tiet_don", con)
rev = rows.merge(det, on='MaHoaDon').groupby('MaHoaDon')['TriGia'].sum()
cust = rows.merge(rev, left_on='MaHoaDon', right_index=True).groupby('MaKhachHang')['TriGia'].sum()
top = cust.sort_values(ascending=False).head(5)
print("\nTop 5 customers by revenue last week:")
print(top)

import sqlite3, pandas as pd
from datetime import date, datetime

con = sqlite3.connect("pos.sqlite")

df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT MaHoaDon, MaKhachHang, TinhTrang, NgayLap FROM don_hang", con)
df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['NgayLap'], errors='coerce', format='mixed')

lo, hi = datetime(2026,5,25), datetime(2026,5,31)
# revenue = completed + shipping (not returned, not cancelled); must have customer code
mask = df['d'].between(lo, hi) & (df['TinhTrang'].isin(['completed','shipping'])) & (df['MaKhachHang'].notna())
rows = df[mask].copy()
print("Orders counted (completed+shipping, has customer):", len(rows))
print(rows['TinhTrang'].value_counts().to_dict())

det = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT MaHoaDon, TriGia FROM chi_tiet_don", con)
rev = rows.merge(det, on='MaHoaDon').groupby('MaHoaDon')['TriGia'].sum()
cust = rows.merge(rev, left_on='MaHoaDon', right_index=True).groupby('MaKhachHang')['TriGia'].sum()
top = cust.sort_values(ascending=False).head(5)
print("\nTop 5 customers by revenue last week:")
print(top)
